top_signals.title: Euro Set to End Five-Week Losing Run on Warsh Remarks
top_signals.summary: The euro was poised to snap a five-week run of losses against the dollar as comments from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh weakened the greenback.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Baltic Block of Russian Grain May Open Black Sea, Latvia Says
top_signals.summary: Europe should block the transit of Russian grain through Baltic ports as that may force Moscow seek ways to open trading on the Black Sea, Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US federal judge denies joint Gemini-CFTC bid to undo $5 million settlement
top_signals.summary: The court noted that Gemini voluntarily settled three weeks before trial and that policy changes do not warrant reopening the judgment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Traders Are Shelling Out Millions to Secure Copper
top_signals.summary: The threat of Trump tariffs is driving huge demand for the red metal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
